_description: Representative response captured from POST /upload with a real PDF invoice. Shows what Gemini 2.0 Flash returns after running through structured-output extraction and the full reconciliation pipeline. Use this when the LLM is rate-limited and you want to walk an evaluator through what the extraction step produces.

fields.message: must be a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format
must be a valid 3-letter ISO-4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, INR)
at least one item required; every item needs description, qty>0, unit_price>0
